inclusions: Accommodation for 4 nights in selected category hotels.
Private vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing as per the itinerary.

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Varanasi
activities: Meet and greet with our representative.
Transfer to the hotel and check in.
In the evening, proceed to Dashashwamedh Ghat.
Enjoy the spiritual atmosphere of the ghats.

days.title: Day 2 – Varanasi Sightseeing
activities: Early morning enjoy a boat ride on the River Ganga.
Visit Kashi Vishwanath Temple for darshan.
Visit Banaras Hindu University and Bharat Kala Bhavan, subject to time availability.
Visit Assi Ghat in the evening.

days.title: Day 3 – Varanasi to Ayodhya
activities: Early morning breakfast and check out from the hotel.
Arrive in Ayodhya and check in to the hotel.
Visit Ram Janmabhoomi Temple for darshan.
In the evening, visit Saryu Ghat and attend the Saryu Aarti, subject to time availability.

days.title: Day 4 – Ayodhya Sightseeing
activities: Early morning visit Ram Janmabhoomi Temple for darshan.
Visit Mani Parvat, subject to time availability.
Explore the local spiritual atmosphere and markets.
In the evening, visit Saryu Ghat.

days.title: Day 5 – Ayodhya to Varanasi Departure
activities: Early morning breakfast and check out from the hotel.
En route, visit Vindhyachal Temple, subject to time availability and departure schedule.
Drop at Varanasi Airport/Railway Station for onward journey with divine memories.
